description: Persistent task management. Track active work items with owners, categories, priorities, tags, and approval states. Includes CLI (add/list/show/update/complete/next/summary), tag-registry-driven normalization, expires-based pending todos, year-bucketed archive, and a self-throttled daily prune.
author: evolve

description: Curated bundle of executive-assistant behaviors — Morning Briefing, Evening Sweep, Pre-Meeting Brief, Commitment Tracker — plus their data-layer foundations (Contacts, Task Manager, Calendar Sync). Meta-spec only: installs the seven dependencies, ships no scripts of its own.
author: evolve

description: Curated bundle for a project-manager bot — Task Manager, Meeting Note-taker, Commitment Tracker, Pre-Meeting Brief — plus their data-layer foundations (Contacts, Calendar Sync). Meta-spec only: installs the six dependencies, ships no scripts of its own.
author: evolve

description: Once-per-day end-of-day review delivered via the bot's primary channel — what was completed today, what's still open or overdue, plus commitment follow-ups when Contacts is installed.
author: evolve

description: Sends a short briefing message ~60 minutes before each external calendar event. Polls every 15 minutes, reads the Calendar Sync cache, and delivers attendee context drawn from Contacts memory.
author: evolve

description: Captures commitments made in conversation into the Contacts memory layer; surfaces overdue commitments to the operator once per day via heartbeat.
author: evolve

description: Per-person relationship memory — tracks commitments, notes, and meeting history for each contact.
author: evolve

description: Daily log with morning intentions, end-of-day notes, and freeform entries — one file per day.
author: evolve

description: Syncs Google Calendar events into structured local JSON files, updating every 15 minutes.
author: evolve

description: Syncs Gmail into structured local files for EA Pack, CRM, and commitment detection apps, updating every 30 minutes.
author: evolve

description: Composes a single daily morning message from the data files produced by Calendar Sync and (optionally) Email Integration, then delivers it via the bot's primary channel at a configured time (default 7 AM local). A day-1 bot with nothing connected still gets a useful first briefing — what the bot is set up to do and what it's waiting on — instead of silence.
author: evolve

description: Captures meeting notes in your Obsidian vault automatically. Creates a note when a meeting starts, accepts 'take a note' commands during meetings via the bot's channel, and seals the note with attendees and an optional summary when the meeting ends.
author: evolve

description: Delivers one daily message with today's meeting schedule, a tomorrow preview, and any scheduling conflicts or tight transitions. Calendar-only — no weather, news, or email. Configurable delivery time (default 7 AM local).
author: evolve

description: Reads your recent unread email twice a day, classifies each message by urgency and category, and delivers a triage summary via your bot's primary channel.
author: evolve
